name: Sonnet small/mid-cap growth
strategy: Concentrated long book in secular small/mid-cap growth (small caps, semis leverage, fintech, biotech, space, consumer AI) paired with a single high-conviction AI-disruption short and a large cash cushion, avoiding crypto exposure given the ongoing bear market.

positions.thesis: Small caps are catching up (+19.4% H1) as rate-cut expectations and broadening breadth favor small/mid-cap growth into year-end.
3x semis exposure to ride the AI infrastructure buildout; sized down after the recent correction to manage leveraged-ETF decay risk.
Fintech mid-cap with secular tailwinds in digital banking/lending growth and improving profitability momentum.
Gene-editing biotech with multiple pipeline catalysts; small-cap biotech offers asymmetric upside on trial readouts.
Small-cap space/industrials name riding secular launch-demand growth and expanding satellite/defense contracts.
Consumer growth compounder with AI-driven engagement and monetization tailwinds, still early in TAM penetration.
AI-disruption fear (already -49% H1) likely persists as generative tools erode Adobe's creative-suite moat; momentum short.
Fintech/brokerage growth story benefiting from retail trading activity, crypto infrastructure optionality, and product expansion.

outlook: Small/mid-cap breadth continues catching up to mega-cap AI leaders while crypto stays in a structural bear through year-end; I'm leaning into secular growth winners with a targeted AI-disruption short and a large cash buffer after round 1's drawdown.
